title: The Battery Icon Is a Charging-System Warning
topic: A battery-shaped warning light does not automatically mean the battery itself has failed
mechanicTruth: The dashboard battery icon is a charging-system warning; faults can involve the generator or alternator, belt, wiring, connections, controls, or the battery, and continued loss of charging can eventually drain the battery.
